body.value:
`BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME` maplib сопряжён с версией consuming app отдельно для
debug и release. На AGP 9.x не задавай `versionName` в library `buildTypes`;
debug override делается через `buildConfigField`, затем проверяется совместно с
APK командой `..\tools\verify-apk-version-matrix.ps1` из root workspace.

review.value: Preserve distinct debug/release app coupling, AGP9 library DSL prohibition, explicit BuildConfig field and actual APK matrix route.

authority_limit.value: Path applicability is reviewed separately from the rule's textual triggers. Every source condition and heading remains attached; no automatic predicate or lifecycle inference. Stored commands and dates do not grant current execution, freshness or product acceptance. Existing instruction clients/checkers remain effective until measured cutover.
